verdict.rationale: Brex offers a documented REST API with token-based authentication (not requiring interactive login) plus webhooks and OpenAPI-described endpoints (transactions, budgets, expenses), which supports scripted/headless automation and CI use. However, there is no explicit CI/CD guide, SDK, or headless-runner documentation, and the openapi.json endpoints probed 404, suggesting incomplete machine-readable spec availability. Missing for 10: explicit CI/headless usage guide, official SDKs/CLI for automation, working OpenAPI spec endpoint.
